messages:
sam: FYI customer acct_98765 says dashboard vs invoice don't match for Feb month-end — dashboard 1,243,200 tokens, invoice 1,867,400. Can someone take?
olivia: account/id and screenshot please?
sam: acct_98765 (Acme Corp). screenshot -> https://uploads.example/acme-invoice-feb.png (contains totals)
raj: pinging @billing-bot to pull the invoice run logs for acct_98765, feb close.
billing-bot: started job inv-debug-3023456789 for acct_98765 period=2026-02 by raj
billing-bot: completed inv-debug-3023456789 — invoice_tokens=1867400 dashboard_tokens=1243200 diff=623200
maria: can we get tokens broken down by plan/tier and by run id? quick query pls.
raj: ran quick aggregation:
```sql
SELECT plan, run_id, SUM(tokens) as tokens
FROM token_ingest
WHERE account_id = 'acct_98765' AND period = '2026-02'
GROUP BY plan, run_id
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```
raj: results (top rows):
```
PRO_PLAN | run_20260201_agg_v2 | 1243200
PRO_PLAN | run_20260201_postproc | 623200
ENTERPRISE | run_20260201_agg_v2 | 0
```
olivia: interesting — looks like postproc run is counted as separate run_id and summed into invoice on top of agg.
maria: that postproc run should feed into the agg output, not be double-counted. suspect backfill job ran twice around cutoff. :thinking_face:
ryan: I see a backfill job that started at 2026-03-01T00:02Z with id backfill-3023456799 — it re-ingested a window that overlaps the Feb aggregator.
raj: logs show postproc produced a synthetic run_id without idempotency key, so aggregator treates it as extra tokens. stack snippet:
```patch
- INSERT INTO token_runs(run_id, account_id, tokens, created_at)
+ INSERT INTO token_runs(run_id, account_id, tokens, created_at)
  VALUES(...) -- missing ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on external backfills
```
raj: reproducer: run backfill for window [2026-02-28T23:58Z, 2026-03-01T00:03Z] => tokens double-counted in invoice rollup.
sam: status? can we fix before CS tells customer?
maria: quick mitigation: add idempotency check + dedupe on run_id, and schedule rollback of duplicate run rows for acct_98765. Will deploy hotfix to staging, then prod. ETA ~90m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
olivia: i'll draft a note to CS with interim explanation and ETA.
raj: hotfix branch ready, applying DB constraint and backfilling dedupe script: `UPDATE token_runs SET deduped=true WHERE run_id IN (select run_id from dup_runs)` — running now.
billing-bot: adjustment job started adj-3023456805 for acct_98765 to reconcile invoice after dedupe
billing-bot: adjustment job completed — invoice adjusted: -623200 tokens, new_invoice_tokens=1243200, adjustment_id=adj-987-3023456805
sam: awesome, please confirm accounting has posted the adjustment and customer notified.
maria: accounting confirmed posting. CS notified (Olivia sent message with explanation + adjusted invoice attached).
olivia: sent customer message, included expected credits and ETA for permanent fix. customer said "thanks, please keep me posted". :thumbsup:
ryan: pushed hotfix to prod (added ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING on ingest, added uniqueness index on run_id). monitoring for 24h.
sam: closing this thread once invoice shows corrected in billing portal and CS confirms customer is satisfied. great work team :trophy:
